verses.1: For the Chief Musician. In instrumental music. Of David.
verses.2: Hear my prayer, O God. Attend to my plea.
verses.3: From the ends of the earth I cry to you. My heart is overwhelmed. In a high rock you raise me up, you lead me.
verses.4: For you have become my refuge, a tower of strength from the face of an enemy.
verses.5: I will dwell in your tent forever. I will hide in the shelter of your wings. Selah.
verses.6: For you, O God, have heard my prayers. You have given an inheritance to those who fear your name.
verses.7: Days upon days of a king you will add to his years, even to the age of generation and generation.
verses.8: The one who sits in the presence of God will dwell there forever. Mercy and truth will guard him.
verses.9: So I will sing your name forever, to pay my vows, day after day.

notes:
Notes
- v. 5: "Selah" is retained as is, following the Hebrew manuscript.
